json_ld.name: Traffic Police Escort for Tourist Groups in East Java
json_ld.description: For large groups — typically around 18 guests or more — JVTO can coordinate an official traffic police escort on certain road segments, when approved by the relevant Traffic Police (Ditlantas) unit. A formal request process, not a marketing add-on — approval is never guaranteed.
